name: website_https
description: Deploys and configures Apache HTTPS on Ubuntu, including package installation, self-signed TLS certificates, a Hello World site, and virtual-host activation.

name: poodle_fix
description: Hardens Apache SSL configuration to allow TLS 1.2 only and restarts affected services.

name: chef_inspec_compliance_checks
description: Provides Chef InSpec compliance checks for SSH root-login policy and HTTPS behavior, including response content and TLS protocol exposure.

name: chef_automate_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, then creates the initial Chef user and organization credentials.

name: chef_infra_server_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Infra Server and creates the initial Chef user, organization, and credentials.
